svg.title: A wagon party playing The Oregon Trail Deluxe, in four beats: a real game screen on the left (title, Matt's General Store, the trail, Kansas River Crossing), the Conky console recording what the party did, including Jed wanting to hunt and the house rule refusing, and the A2UI screen showing the same numbers; the game screens are real, the rest is schematic

g.text: Ma read pattern "The Art of War"
refused: house rule, no hunting above 500 food
Ma: we push on. Sorry, Jed.
